name: daily-digest
description: Dogfood chain. Reads today's git activity across ~/dev/platform sub-repos, groups by concern, writes a markdown digest. Runs daily on cron on the arch box. If it jams, we find the platform bug before a customer does.

agents.task: Run: for repo in mentiko mentiko-control-plane mentiko-www mentiko-marketplace mentiko-ai-gateway; do (cd ~/dev/platform/$repo && git log --since='24 hours ago' --oneline --all 2>/dev/null); done. Write the combined output to commits.txt. Then emit event commits-collected.
Read commits.txt. Group commits into buckets: feat, fix, chore, docs, test. Write groups.md with one section per bucket, bullets per commit. Emit grouped.
Read groups.md. Write a 200-word narrative summary to digest.md: what shipped, what was fixed, what's in-flight. Prepend the date. Emit digest-ready.
